reference_use: Read for interface and mechanism comparison only; no reference package import or vendoring.

observations: The original cv1/cv2/m/cv3 interface and sum are retained by subclassing the repository RepC3.
DilatedReparamBlock uses depthwise large-kernel and dilated Conv-BN branches then fuses kernels for deployment.
UniRepLKNetBlock adds normalization, squeeze/excitation, feedforward projections, GRN, optional gamma and DropPath. None of those branches or dependencies are copied into BSC v1.
ConvolutionalAttention uses learned 7x1/1x7 strip kernels, spatial softmax/channel normalization, transposed-kernel projection and SyncBatchNorm.
BSC v1 instead gathers fixed +/-1,2,3 offsets in four directions, uses replicate edges and one shared sigmoid gate over [Z,M,D]. It does not import CFBlock/extra_modules/timm/CUDA extensions.

mechanism_scope: The learned gate decides whether paired endpoint context can supplement the center. There is no monotonicity constraint: greater endpoint agreement need not increase the gate.
This is feature context at P3, not segmentation, topology reconstruction or a forced bridge across cracks.
Original CBR samples inside/outside candidate box boundaries; BSC operates on feature-grid bilateral context before the decoder.

Residual and local-difference formulas are not claimed as original. The candidate is use of same-direction bilateral geometry in P3 context judgment. No guaranteed accuracy gain or academic novelty is claimed.
